classFaq.rolesQ: Which roles can the {class} play in {game}?

beginnerA.easy: Yes. The {class} is considered beginner friendly: it is sturdy and easy to understand.
beginnerA.medium: Somewhat. The {class} is easy to learn but needs a bit more practice than the simplest classes.
beginnerA.hard: It is better for experienced players. The {class} has lots of tools and rewards experience, so the learning curve is steeper.

classFaq.soloQ: Is the {class} good for solo players?

soloA.good: Yes. The {class} does very well on its own, thanks to self-healing, sturdiness or a companion.
soloA.medium: Yes, with some practice. The {class} handles solo play well but needs care with bigger groups of enemies.
soloA.weak: Not really. The {class} is slower or more vulnerable alone and shines mostly in groups.
